title: Ousiyan Paindi Reh Gaye
body:
Ousiyan Paundi Reh Gaye Sughra Veer Nayi Aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Ena Ujre Gharan Vich Mein Rul Jana
Je Tu Na Phera Paaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Teri Yaad De Saharay Zindagi Guzar Laan Gi
Tun Jeevain Veer The Thon Sawaan Mein Vaar Daan Gi
Nayi Veer Udaasi Teri Mukni Muk Jaana Mein Maa Jaaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaalay Libaas Vich Mein Mastooran Vekhiyan
Haye Rait Te Tarapda Tera Vekheya Mein Asghar
Tere Khwaban Menu Maar Mukaya
Tu Menu Lain Na Aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Bawaan Ch Teri Akbar Haye Nikle Jaan Meri
Bas Ik Eh Poori Karde Hasrat Khuda Ay Meri
Es Vaste Tenu Bhen Numani Ne
Kayi Vaari Veer Bulaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Beemar Hogayi Aan Tere Hijr Ch Aaja
Daadi Samajh Ke Menu Dukhra Mera Muka Ja
Pardes Tera Kyun Bhen Vichari Nu
Haye Akbar Raas Na Aaya
<<DIVIDER>>
Kinj Vekhaan Gi Mein Akbar Seenay ch Tere Barchi
Likh Likh Ke Ro Rayi Ay Teri Sain Sahar Arzi
Kyun Kalmagoan Laikhaan Hari Nal
Haye Aisa Veer Kamaya
